codeReview.summary: The cleanup feature successfully deleted 4 duplicate backend framework files (SyncEngine.ts, EntityRegistry.ts, HandlerRegistry.ts, OperationSorter.ts) and their test file (OperationSorter.test.ts). Imports were updated to use library equivalents. Build passes, backend tests pass (198 pass, 3 pre-existing failures unrelated to changes), and library tests pass (273). No orphaned imports of deleted files remain. The worker correctly retained files that still have backend-specific value: SyncPipeline.ts (used as middleware), BaseSyncHandler.ts (extends library version with app-specific logging), StatefulSyncHandler.ts (extends BaseSyncHandler for stateful handlers), patch-utils.ts (used by stateful handlers), and sync-logger.ts (rich structured logging not in library).

issues.description: SyncEngineDeps interface is duplicated between backend types.ts and the library. The backend version imports 14 repository types creating a tight coupling. Consider whether this should be a library type with generics, or if the comment 'must be kept in sync' is a maintenance burden that should be addressed in a future refactor.

BaseSyncHandler still imports sync-logger.ts from a local path. The sync-logger.ts file was listed as potentially deletable in the feature description ('if library version sufficient'), but was retained. This is correct because the library does not provide an equivalent rich structured logging service with metrics, alerts, and correlation tracking. However, the feature description listed this as a candidate for deletion — the worker should have explicitly documented in the handoff why it was kept, which they did.

GenericSyncHandler.ts and SyncHandlerBuilder.ts still exist in the backend despite being migrated to the library in feature 'migrate-generic-handler-builder'. The backend's registry.ts imports from the library (verified), but the local files in handlers/core/ remain. These appear to be dead code — no imports reference them. They should be deleted to complete the cleanup.
SyncHandlerBuilder.ts still exists locally in handlers/core/ despite the library version being available and used by registry.ts. This is dead code with no remaining imports.

types.ts in handlers/core/ defines IBuilderConfig and related types. These types are only needed if GenericSyncHandler.ts and SyncHandlerBuilder.ts are kept locally. Since registry.ts now imports IGenericHandlerConfig from the library, this file may also be unused. Verify and delete if orphaned.

summary: The backend-cleanup-duplicate-files feature is a PASS. The worker correctly identified and deleted 4 duplicate framework files (SyncEngine.ts, EntityRegistry.ts, HandlerRegistry.ts, OperationSorter.ts) plus their test file, updated all imports to use library equivalents, and retained files that still provide backend-specific value. Build passes, tests pass (198 backend + 273 library, with 3 pre-existing unrelated failures), and no orphaned imports of deleted files remain. Two non-blocking issues: (1) GenericSyncHandler.ts, SyncHandlerBuilder.ts, and possibly types.ts in handlers/core/ remain as dead code with no imports — they should be deleted in a follow-up; (2) SyncEngineDeps is duplicated between backend and library with a maintenance comment.
